Why is planting Wheat Seeds at the end of Summer a useful strategy in Stardew Valley?

Planting Wheat Seeds at the end of Summer is a cheap way to ensure a tile doesn't lose its tilled status, and its watered status if supplied by a sprinkler, at the season change. Wheat is ideal for this because it lasts two seasons and has a very short growth time.
